coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 SEED 这一种 128 位分组密码：128 位块和密钥、16 轮 Feistel、F/G 函数、S0/S1 与 SS-box、Key0..Key3 与 KC 密钥调度、RFC 4269 附录 B 的四组向量和轮中间值、CMS/TLS 使用及其现行限制；不把 AES、Camellia、ARIA、CMS/TLS 协议或工作模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the SEED 128-bit block cipher: 128-bit block and key, 16-round Feistel, F/G functions, S0/S1 and SS-boxes, the Key0..Key3 and KC key schedule, the four Appendix B vectors and per-round values, CMS/TLS use and current limitations. It does not absorb AES, Camellia, ARIA, the CMS/TLS protocols, modes of operation or the whole library.
